summary: Radial bar chart of twelve months, denser toward each tip; hovering or the arrow keys roll a month's value into the centre.

attributes.name: label
attributes.description: Heading text. Read once on connect.

keyboard.action: Inspect the next month; the first press starts at January.
Inspect the previous month; the first press starts at December.

accessibility: The dial canvas is focusable with `role="img"` and an `aria-label` that starts with `label` and lists the hours for every month of the selected year.
The centre value and month are text but not a live region.
The year switch is a `role="group"` labelled `Year`, with `aria-pressed` buttons for 2025 and 2026.
Moving the pointer off the dial or moving focus away returns the centre to the yearly total.
motion: With reduced motion, bars appear without the sweep, year changes apply at once, the current month does not pulse and the centre text changes without rolling.
notes: Data is built in for 2025 and 2026. In 2026, November and December are empty and October is highlighted as the current month regardless of the real date.
The dial is a fixed 236px square.

data.note: The monthly values for 2025 and 2026 and the highlighted current month are invented; only `label` can be set.
